qe: In India, the poverty line based on calorie norms and a basket of consumption was most famously reviewed by which committee whose methodology was used for official poverty estimates from 2009?
qh: भारत में कैलोरी मानदंड तथा उपभोग टोकरी पर आधारित गरीबी रेखा की सर्वाधिक प्रसिद्ध समीक्षा किस समिति ने की, जिसकी पद्धति 2009 से आधिकारिक गरीबी अनुमानों में प्रयुक्त हुई?
e: Garibi rekha (poverty line) tay karne ke liye samay-samay par samitiyan bani. 1979 me Alagh samiti ne calorie ke aadhaar par garibi rekha banai; 1993 me Lakdawala samiti ne usi ko aage badhaya. Iske baad Tendulkar Committee (adhyaksh: Suresh Tendulkar), jiski report 2009 me aayi, ne sirf calorie par nirbhar na rahne ki sifarish ki - usme khadyan, shiksha, swasthya, bijli, kapde jaise kharchon ka bhi dhyan rakha gaya; yahi wajah hai ki 2009 ke baad ke aadhikarik aakde isi vidhi par bane. 2014 me Rangarajan samiti ne alag aakalan kiya, lekin uski sifarishein aadhikarik roop se sweekar nahi hui; isliye woh vikalp 'official estimates' wale hisse se mel nahi khaata. Kelkar samiti kar-tatha-rajkosh sudhar se judi thi, garibi se nahi. Exam point: garibi rekha ki pramukh samitiyan - Alagh (1979), Lakdawala (1993), Tendulkar (2009, bahu-aayaam drishtikon), Rangarajan (2014).

qe: The Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) published globally is prepared by which two institutions, and how many dimensions does it use?
qh: विश्व स्तर पर प्रकाशित बहुआयामी गरीबी सूचकांक (MPI) किन दो संस्थाओं द्वारा तैयार किया जाता है, और इसमें कितने आयाम होते हैं?
oe: World Bank and IMF; four dimensions
UNDP and Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative; three dimensions
NITI Aayog and RBI; two dimensions
oh: विश्व बैंक तथा आईएमएफ; चार आयाम
यूएनडीपी तथा ऑक्सफोर्ड पॉवर्टी एंड ह्यूमन डेवलपमेंट इनिशिएटिव; तीन आयाम
नीति आयोग तथा आरबीआई; दो आयाम
e: Multidimensional Poverty Index (bahuaayami garibi suchkank) har saal UNDP tatha Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI) milkar Global MPI Report me jaari karte hain. Isme teen aayam hain - swasthya (health), shiksha (education) tatha jeevan-star (standard of living); in teeno aayamon me kul 10 suchak (indicators) aate hain, jaise poshan, bal-mrityu, school ki upasthiti, bijli, peene ka paani, swachhata tatha sampatti. Koi vyakti kitne suchakon se vanchit hai, uske aadhaar par garibi ki tivrta tay hoti hai. World Bank tatha IMF aarthik nitiyon ke sansthan hain aur garibi ke aankde alag tarah se dete hain - woh Global MPI jaari nahi karte, isliye pehla vikalp galat hai. WTO vyapar ki sanstha hai, UNICEF bachchon ke liye; NITI Aayog bharat me National MPI (bharat ka rashtriya MPI) jaari karta hai jo Global MPI ki vidhi par bana hota hai. Exam point: Global MPI = UNDP aur OPHI, teen aayam (swasthya, shiksha, jeevan-star) tatha 10 suchak.

qe: Under the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act, 2005, how many days of guaranteed wage employment is assured to a rural household in a financial year?
qh: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम, 2005 के अंतर्गत एक वित्तीय वर्ष में एक ग्रामीण परिवार को कितने दिन के गारंटीयुक्त मजदूरी रोजगार का आश्वासन है?
e: MGNREGA 2005 me ek gaon ke parivar (ghar) ko ek vitta varsha me kam se kam 100 din ke gulamiya (mazdoori) rozgar ki guarantee milti hai; parivar ke purshton ke hisaab se zyada din bhi mil sakte hain, lekin 100 din ka aashwasan har parivar ko hai. Iska swaroop 'mang-par adharit' (demand-driven) hai - kaam tab chalu hota hai jab gaon me kaam ki maang aaye, sarkar ke paas 100 din ke andar kaam dene ki kanuni zimmedari hoti hai; agar kaam na mile to bhatta (unemployment allowance) milta hai. Isi wajah se 50 din wala vikalp galat hai kyunki woh kanuni aashwasan se aadha hai. Kaam me bhoomi sudhar jaisi suchanaayein shaamil hain, isliye ise 'mazdoori ka adhikaar' ke roop me dekha jaata hai. Bharat me is yojna par aksar 15% se adhik kharch hota hai, aur yah gaon ki arthavyavastha me mahatvapurn sthirata deta hai; isi liye is yojna ko samajik suraksha ka bada upaay kaha jaata hai. Exam point: MGNREGA = 100 din ki mazdoori guarantee, mang-adharit, kaam na mile to bhatta; 2005 ka kanoon, Gram Panchayat mukhya sanstha.

qe: In India, a large part of the agricultural workforce is employed on small farms but produces much less than it could, so that if some workers were removed the output would not fall. That type of unemployment is called:
qh: भारत में कृषि कार्यबल का बड़ा भाग छोटे जोतों पर काम करता है पर उत्पादन उससे कहीं कम होता है, इतना कि कुछ श्रमिक हटा दिए जाएँ तो उत्पादन घटेगा नहीं। इस प्रकार की बेरोजगारी कहलाती है -
e: Jab kheti me zaroorat se zyada log kaam karte hain aur kuch logon ko hataane par bhi utpadan waisa hi rehta hai, to use 'apratyaksh' ya 'chhipi' berozgari (disguised unemployment) kehte hain; isme logon ko kaam dikhta hai lekin unka poora shram upyogi nahi hota. Yeh sthiti bharat ke chhote-jot wale kshetr me aam hai, jahan parivarik shram ka bada hissa ek hi zameen par lagta hai. Mausami berozgari (seasonal) tab hoti hai jab kaam keval kuch mahine milta hai, jaise fasal katne ya bonay ke samay; isliye woh vikalp galat hai. Sanrachnatmak berozgari me nae praudyogiki se kaam kam ho jaata hai jaise uncha swachalan - woh alag vishay hai. Chakriya berozgari me maandi ki girti maang se kaam chalta hai, jo vikasit deshon me aam hai, bharat ke gaon me nahi. Isliye is prashn me asool yahi hai ki 'zyada log, kam kaam' wali sthiti ko chhipi berozgari kehte hain. Exam point: chhipi (disguised) berozgari = kheti me zaroorat se adhik shram, hadtane par utpadan na gire; mausami = fasal ke mausam ki berozgari.

qe: The Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS), which provides official estimates of unemployment and labour force participation in India, is conducted by:
qh: भारत में बेरोजगारी तथा श्रम-बल सहभागिता के आधिकारिक अनुमान देने वाला आवधिक श्रम बल सर्वेक्षण (PLFS) किसके द्वारा किया जाता है?
oh: सांख्यिकी और कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन मंत्रालय के अंतर्गत राष्ट्रीय सांख्यिकीय कार्यालय
e: PLFS (Aavdhik shram bal sarvekshan) 2017 se National Statistical Office (NSO) chala raha hai, jo Sankhyiki aur Karyakram Karyanvayan Mantralay (MoSPI) ke antargat aata hai. Iska mukhya uddeshya shehri kshetra me har teen mahine (chauthai) tatha gaon kshetra me har saal (varshana) shram bal ka aakalan dena hai; isme rozgar tatha berozgari ke saath-saath kaam ki shartein (jaisay regular kaam, apna kaam) par bhi jaankari milti hai. Labour Bureau, Shimla pehle garibi tatha rozgar ke aakde deta tha aur woh kai anya sarvekshan karta hai, lekin aaj ka aadhikarik PLFS NSO ke dwara hota hai, isliye pehla vikalp galat hai. NITI Aayog niti-banane wali sanstha hai - woh aakde nahi juttai; Reserve Bank of India banking tatha mone-tarakki se juda hai. Isliye sahi uttar NSO (MoSPI) hai. Exam point: PLFS = NSO/MoSPI ke dwara; shehri kshetra me chaturmasik, gaon me varshik; yeh hi berozgari dar (UR) tatha shram-bhaagidari dar (LFPR) ka srot hai.

qe: Which of the following is NOT one of the three components of the Human Development Index?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा मानव विकास सूचकांक (HDI) के तीन घटकों में शामिल नहीं है?
oe: Expected and mean years of schooling
Rate of inflation in the economy
oh: प्रति व्यक्ति सकल राष्ट्रीय आय (क्रय शक्ति समता पर)
e: Human Development Index (manav vikas suchkank) kisi desh ke vikas ko teen aayamon me maapta hai: pehla swasthya, jiske liye janm ke samay jeevan pratyasha (life expectancy at birth); doosra shiksha, jiske liye apekshit vidyalayi varsha (expected years of schooling) tatha ausat vidyalayi varsha (mean years of schooling); aur teesra jeevan-star, jiske liye prati-vyakti sakal rashtriya aay (GNI per capita, PP yaani-kray-shakti-samta ke aadhaar par). Teen aayam me se har ek ka score nikaalkar unka geometric average HDI banta hai; yeh report UNDP har saal Human Development Report me jaari karta hai. Mahangai ki dar (inflation) HDI ka hissa nahi hai - woh keemat-sthirata ka suchak hai, vikas ka nahi. Isliye inflation wala vikalp sahi uttar hai kyunki prashn 'shaamil nahi' poochh raha hai. Mehngai se aay ki kharid-shakti prabhavit hoti hai, lekin HDI ki vidhi me usse seedha shaamil nahi kiya jaata. Exam point: HDI ke teen ghatak = jeevan pratyasha, shiksha ke varsha (do suchak) tatha prati-vyakti GNI (PPP); jaari karta hai UNDP.

qe: NITI Aayog's National Multidimensional Poverty Index for India, like the Global MPI, measures deprivation in which of the following sets of three dimensions?
qh: नीति आयोग का राष्ट्रीय बहुआयामी गरीबी सूचकांक, वैश्विक MPI की भाँति, निम्नलिखित तीन आयामों में वंचना को मापता है -
oe: Health, education and standard of living
e: NITI Aayog bharat ka National MPI (rashtriya bahuaayami garibi suchkank) jaari karta hai, jo Global MPI ki vidhi par bana hai. Iske teen aayam wahi hain - swasthya, shiksha tatha jeevan-star; in aayamon me kul 12 suchak aate hain, jaise poshan, bal-mrityu, maatritva-swasthya, vidyalayi upasthiti, khanane ka gas, swachhata, peene ka paani, bijli, sampatti. Har suchak ka alag bhaar (weight) hota hai; koi parivar kuch suchakon se vanchit hone par 'bahuaayami garibi' ki shreni me aa jaata hai. 2023 ki report 'National MPI: A Progress Review' me kaha gaya ki 2013-14 tatha 2019-21 ke beech lagbhag 13.5 crore log bahuaayami garibi se baahar nikle. Aay-bachat-nivesh ya rojgar-niryat-vikas jaisi jaannoti is suchkank ka hissa nahi hain; isliye woh vikalp galat hain. Is suchkank ka adhaar UP tatha NFHS jaisi sarvekshan ki jaankari hoti hai. Exam point: National MPI = swasthya, shiksha, jeevan-star (12 suchak); Global MPI me 10 suchak hote hain; 2023 ki report 13.5 crore logon ke garibi se baahar aane ki baat karti hai.
